name: 夜用液体卫生巾瞬感贴身款
description: 夜用液体卫生巾套图：超薄贴身、干爽防侧漏、夜间安心

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm coral rose #E8837B and blush #F7DEDA rounded-card fields for info and scene shots, deep rose #D4605A for closing
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, gentle front or front-left key, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte blush board and light wood tabletop
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with rounded-corner cards
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in the accent rose only
styleLock.presentationRules: pad shown flat in natural curve or pack standing upright, stable scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft feminine personal-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm coral rose #E8837B, deep rose #D4605A, blush pink #F7DEDA and charcoal text #3A3A3C; bright soft studio lighting with gentle front key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icons in the accent rose only; clean high-end personal-care product photography mixed with minimal rounded-card infographic elements; stable product scale with the pad shown flat or the pack upright; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, pack standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pack standing upright and centered, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no podium or stage blocks, no cartoon character art, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达贴身干爽的核心卖点，承接点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, pack upright with one pad leaning beside it
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one pad leaning against the pack, a small rounded white badge card
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper right 35% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pack standing upright with one pad leaning beside it at a slight 3/4 angle, occupying 50-60%. Background warm coral rose #E8837B, soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow. A rounded white label area in the upper right reading 「{selling_point_1}」 and a small pill badge below it reading 「{callout_1}」, with generous negative space around the text zone. Negative: no cartoon character art, no efficacy numbers or percentages, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大普通卫生巾表面潮湿反渗的痛点
shots.camera: matched straight-on split screen, identical framing on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat and heavy, right panel soft and clean
shots.background: blush pink #F7DEDA field with two rounded panels
shots.textZone: one short caption under each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched rounded panels with identical straight-on framing on a blush pink #F7DEDA field. Left panel: an abstract ordinary pad under flat heavy light, its surface looking dull and slow to absorb. Right panel: {product} lying in the same pose under soft clean light with a visibly dry fresh surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One short caption 「{callout_2}」 under the left panel and 「{callout_3}」 under the right panel. Each panel occupies 50-60% of the frame, no extra whitespace. Negative: no real model or body parts, no fabricated test data or percentages, no blood or bodily-fluid imagery, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入夜间起居场景，营造整夜安心感
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level, candid handheld feel over a nightstand
shots.lighting: warm 3200K bedside lamp glow from the right blended with soft ambient light, soft contact shadow
shots.background: warm beige bedroom wall #F3D9CE with gentle depth
shots.props: a neatly folded blanket and a small ceramic cup, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 40% for copy

Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel. Warm 3200K bedside lamp glow from the right blended with soft ambient light, soft contact shadow. Background warm beige bedroom wall #F3D9CE with gentle depth. The pack occupies 40-50% of the frame, generous negative space on the left 40% carrying 「{selling_point_2}」. Negative: no visible person or face, no hands covering the product, no cluttered mess, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用表层材质与导流纹路微距证明亲肤工艺
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing fine surface texture
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the top surface of {product}, tight zoom on the soft cover sheet, its fine texture and subtle embossed flow channels. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Skimming side light from the right revealing the fine surface texture. Neutral warm-grey matte board background #EFE9E3. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace as the texture is the subject. Negative: no liquid or stains on the surface, no blurry subject, no invented material labels, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.textZone: one short caption under each panel

shots.intent: 俯拍展示巾身形态与结构，消除尺码疑虑

shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF with a thin rose ruler graphic
shots.props: thin dimension callout lines with blank measurement placeholders and a rounded spec card
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the lower 35% for the spec card
shots.textZone: dimension callout lines and one rounded spec card
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec infographic for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a top-down 90-degree angle, the pad fully unrolled beside its pack showing the natural silhouette. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background clean white #FFFFFF with a thin rose ruler graphic. Simple dimension callout lines with blank measurement placeholders plus labels 「{callout_6}」 and 「{callout_7}」, and a rounded spec card with empty cells in the lower 35% negative space. shots.intent: 以问答结构降低购买顾虑，留白待后合成资质文案

shots.background: blush pink #F7DEDA with two rounded white FAQ cards
shots.props: two rounded white FAQ cards with short question lines and blank answer lines
shots.whitespace: generous negative space inside the FAQ cards
shots.textZone: FAQ card question lines and blank answer lines
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust FAQ screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pack standing at a slight 3/4 angle on the right, straight-on layout view. Even clean high-key studio light. Background blush pink #F7DEDA with two rounded white FAQ cards carrying short question lines 「{selling_point_3}」 and 「{callout_8}」, their answer lines left blank for post compositing. The product occupies 40-50%, generous negative space inside the cards. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, hygiene-standard numbers, test reports or award badges, no QR code, no membership badge, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 收口促单，突出组合装与行动按钮
shots.camera: slight 3/4 group angle, two packs with one pad arranged low in frame
shots.lighting: punchier soft studio light with gentle top glow, soft contact shadows
shots.props: a rounded white CTA button below the group
shots.whitespace: generous negative space above the group for a short headline
shots.textZone: headline area above and CTA button below
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two packs with one pad arranged in a low group at a slight 3/4 angle, occupying 55-60% overall. Background deep rose #D4605A, punchier soft studio light with a gentle top glow, soft contact shadows. Generous negative space above the group for a short headline 「{selling_point_4}」 and a rounded white CTA button below the group reading 「{callout_9}」. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdown timers, no cartoon character art, no floating product without contact shadow, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 珊瑚玫瑰 3D 圆台场景、粉色包装袋与巾身斜倚主视觉；P2 三枚线性图标卖点卡与大字标题卖点屏；P3 巾身特写加灰色对玫瑰色 VS 双面板对比；P4 深玫瑰场景屏（龟背竹叶与红框画）；P5 浅粉尺寸标尺信息屏；P6 对比复用加生活场景卡；P7 场景卡与产品参数表（品名：夜用卫生巾）；P8 参数表（主要成分：无纺布、高吸收性树脂、PE底膜；产品尺寸与片数规格）、超薄日用组合卡；P9 三段式 FAQ 信任屏。品类判定：源夹名为洗护，但按图判主品为卫生巾（个护用品），参数表品名「夜用卫生巾」为硬证据，taxonomy 无专设卫生巾类目，按最接近的「护肤个护/女性护理」判定。已剥离：包装上的卡通少女插画与品牌字样（樱语/千图等字标）、二维码与「加入会员」角标、抑菌率与负离子浓度数值、0.1CM 厚度、330MM 与 240MM 尺寸、50片/倍数等全部数值与功效断言（抑菌止痒、祛味、日本黑科技等），原文数值一律改为 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 占位；源页尺寸自相矛盾（0.1CM 超薄 vs 330MM*450MM vs 日用 240MM），两种说法均未作为事实写入，尺寸一律留空占位；模特征人面容未采用，脱敏后无模特。
